title: Akber ne kaha rokar
body:
Akbar ne kaha rokar
Akbar ne kaha rokar
Shabih e imam e zama(n) khechte hain
Tasawwur mei tasweer e jaan khechte hain
Shabih e imam e, Kaha roo keh Akbar neh aiy dard tham jaa Ke seene se baba sinaa khechte hain
Shabih e imam e
(Akbar neh kaha roo kar aiy dard zara tham jaa, Baba mere seene se sinaa khech rahey hain) x2
1. (Aiy behtey lahu rukjaa) x2 hai wasta sughra ka
<<MINI>>

Akbar neh kaha roo kar aiy dard zara tham jaa
Baba mere seene se sinaa khech rahey hain
